about_the_game:
Playing as a hunted cyborg, seeking your purpose, climbing up from the mysterious facility, and uncovering the secrets beneath (and above) the surface.

In this first-person action game, you can parkour through a delicate environment built by the Unreal 5 Engine and fight against other evil machines with the assistance of a mysterious voice.

- Climbing, dashing, wall-running, grappling, throwing, reflecting enemy projectiles, breaking through obstacles, and using the environment to your advantage!

- Destroy enemies and use their abilities! Control drones to move around, or grab missiles and use them to rocket jump!

- Search for additional upgrades and customize your way through the enemy lines!

name: XELVITA

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-13900K / AMD Ryzen 9 7950X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: XELVITA is a first-person action game—Experience fast-paced first-person action as a hunted cyborg, traverse enemy lines in an abandoned sci-fi facility, and team up with an unknown intelligence to fight against the mechanical threat.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese
